newsitem.title: CHINA: China firms raise 52.3 bln yuan from share issues.
newsitem.headline: China firms raise 52.3 bln yuan from share issues.

text.p: Chinese listed firms had raised 52.3 billion yuan from domestic share issues by the end of July since the mid-1980s when Beijing first allowed firms to issue shares, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.

During the same period, 24 Chinese companies issued shares outside the country, raising a total of $4.44 billion, the paper quoted Hong Hu, deputy director of the State Commission for Economic Restructing, as telling a seminar in Beijing.

Hong said listing of Chinese companies on overseas markets had proved successful, with the firms learning from international experience to improve themselves, and that Beijing would allow more to issue shares abroad. He gave no details.
